purpose: A gate for the upstream skill corpus that is FIXED BEFORE SCORING and mechanically applicable: a third party reading t4's gap.json can reproduce every score, every veto and every action. No post-hoc rationalisation: this file is authored before any row is scored, and verdict-table.md pins its sha256.

authoredBeforeScoring.statement: This rubric was written to disk before the first row scored. verdict-table.md records the sha256 of this file and states that the score table was derived from that exact revision.
orderOfOperations: 4. score rows mechanically per this file

captainRulings: Row set = t4 table rows with class in {adoptable, uncertain}; excluded rows get one tail line with count + reason.

Fixed columns; a missing column fails the gate: id | 上游技能/领域项 | t4 判定 | rubric 各维度得分 | 合计 | 建议动作(install|adapt-then-install|skip) | 实施代价(fileCount+dirCount、是否动 harness seam) | 与 t5 落地能力的重复度(已等价|部分等价|无增量) | 不实施的损失 | 证据引用
'不实施的损失' may not be empty or 'none': either a concrete capability loss, or '零增量（t5/本地已等价，证据：file:line）'.
Rubric must be formed before scoring ('先成型再打分'), and the threshold->action mapping must be a predicate, not a case-by-case judgement.
V1 已等价 => skip (total does not participate); V2 部分等价 => at most adapt-then-install; V3 renaming a frozen name => skip; V4 requiring the task-board model/runner to be replaced => skip.
Resolution order is fixed: veto -> coupling -> total. Boundary samples are resolved by the same order, never case by case.
couplingMeasurement present => harnessCoupling may not be judged 'none'.
portCost fileCount/dirCount null is a distinct 'unknown-cost' band (not 0, not the worst band); it does not block install, but the row's loss cell must say '代价未知 + 需 t9 实测'.
'重复度' is ONE dimension presented in TWO places: the score dimension absorbs both 'existing skill' and 't5 landed capability' evidence; the column prints its classification mapping.

Frozen names: agent_teams_* tool names, the generated /agent-teams gesture + /agent-teams-<profile-key> family (mechanism: lib/command.js:3-5,12-17,75-76,95-100 + the profiles.* key set), the profiles.mpd key, the mpd preset id.
The ledger (docs/omo-parity-ledger.md + .zh-CN.md) is written by t5; t8 only lists which gate conclusions must enter it.

inputs.rowSetRule: items[] where class == 'adoptable' or class == 'uncertain'. Items with class 'already-have' or 'not-applicable' are NOT scored.
inputs.nearDuplicatePolicy: Rows that are the same skill in two upstream roots (same name, >=95% same semantics) are scored separately but counted ONCE in the action tally; the dedupe pair is named in verdict-table.md.
inputs.fieldPolicy: A row missing any of id/class/upstreamSemantics/repoCounterpart/overlap/upstreamHarnessCoupling/couplingMeasurement/portCost/relevanceToGoals/evidenceCitations is marked blocked-scoring instead of estimated.

preChecks.name: same-name local-corpus check
preChecks.why: t4 emits repoCounterpart as the string 'null ...' for two rows whose skill NAME already exists in this repo's skills/. Scoring 'no counterpart' would overstate the increment.
preChecks.procedure: ls -d skills/<name> for every scored row; if a same-name local skill dir exists, the row's repetition evidence MUST cite it (and its measured drift) even when t4 wrote repoCounterpart starting with 'null'.

preChecks.name: coupling measurement floor
preChecks.why: captain ruling + t4 emits raw token counts, so a measured-but-short coupling list cannot be scored as 'none'.
preChecks.procedure: if couplingMeasurement is a non-empty string and the coupling list is empty or the literal 'none', treat it as one HARD 'unclassified' class (D4 <= 1).

preChecks.name: unknown-cost band
preChecks.procedure: if portCost.fileCount and portCost.dirCount are BOTH null, D3 = 'U' (unknown). 'U' contributes 1 point, never blocks install, and forces the loss cell to '代价未知 + 需 t9 实测'.

preChecks.name: duplicate id census
preChecks.procedure: count items and unique ids; report duplicate ids as an input-shape deviation (they do not enter the scored row set in this dataset).

dimensions.name: 能力影响面 (capability impact)

capabilityClassRules.target-surface-absent: the skill's content targets a surface that does not exist in this repo (e.g. another product's CLI/UX). Evidence: upstreamSemantics + repoCounterpart.
capabilityClassRules.equivalent-local-capability: t4 overlap states the local mechanism already covers it.
capabilityClassRules.same-name-counterpart-differs: P1 found skills/<name> locally but SKILL.md content differs materially (line-count/file-count drift measured).
capabilityClassRules.marginal-variant-of-existing-intent: t4 overlap names an existing local skill covering a neighbouring intent.
capabilityClassRules.new-capability-class: no local counterpart, and the skill carries a workflow/artifact type this repo does not have.
capabilityClassRules.cross-task-mechanism: the skill changes how work is executed across tasks (runner/DAG/engine class), not just adds content.

dimensions.evidenceRequirement: every row cites the capabilityClass + the file:line/field that fixed it

dimensions.name: 与本次四项目标的相关性 (relevance to the four goals)
dimensions.procedure: map t4 relevanceToGoals {高->3, 中->2, 低->1, 无->0}; D2 = max over the four goal values; record the argmax goal id.

dimensions.name: 移植成本 (port cost; higher = cheaper)
dimensions.procedure: fileTier = 0 if fileCount<=1; 1 if fileCount in 2..3; 2 if fileCount in 4..20; 3 if fileCount>20. penalty = fileTier + 2*harnessSeamChange + 1*binaryDependency + 1*credentialDependency. D3 = 3 if penalty==0; 2 if penalty==1; 1 if penalty in 2..3; 0 if penalty>=4.

unknownCost.note: distinct band: not 0, not the worst; does not block install

dimensions.name: 上游 harness 专有耦合度 (upstream harness coupling; higher = more portable)
dimensions.procedure: Classify every entry of upstreamHarnessCoupling with the keyword table below (first match wins, case-insensitive). HARD = count of hard entries; SOFT = count of soft entries. If the raw list is the literal 'none' or empty AND couplingMeasurement is empty/absent => D4 = 3. Else if HARD == 0 => D4 = 2. Else if HARD == 1 => D4 = 1. Else D4 = 0.
dimensions.default: HARD 'unclassified' (conservative: an unmatched coupling string is never treated as portable)

dimensions.name: 与现有技能的重复/冲突度 (duplication vs existing local capability; higher = less duplication)
dimensions.presentation: ONE dimension in TWO places: this score AND the verdict-table column '重复度' (classification mapping).

classificationDerivation.predicate: t4 overlap states the local mechanism already covers the capability (marker phrases: 'local mechanism is', 'SAME concept', 'already implemented locally', 'duplicate an existing capability'), OR P1 finds a same-name local SKILL.md that is byte-identical.
t4 overlap names a local counterpart with partial coverage, OR P1 finds a same-name local skill whose content differs materially, OR the row is partly covered by an existing local skill.
t4 overlap is 'none' AND P1 finds no same-name local skill AND couplingMeasurement does not declare the mechanism impossible locally.
couplingMeasurement / overlap declares the usable half inseparable from an upstream-only mechanism ('not separable', 'harness lacks', 'no local counterpart (t2 D3)').

dimensions.columnNote: The three frozen words are preserved as prefixes; the parenthetical disambiguates the two 无增量 sub-cases (正交 = adds nothing but duplicates nothing; 不可用 = the mechanism cannot exist here).

weightsAndTotal.thresholdRationale: 15 = 50% of 30: a candidate must earn at least half of the weighted evidence before it is worth a skills/** change and its VENDOR_LOCK re-pin.

vetoes.effect: action = skip; total does not participate; loss = 零增量
action is CAPPED at adapt-then-install (install is forbidden for that row)

vetoes.predicate: the skill's usable path requires renaming or changing a frozen name (agent_teams_* tools; the /agent-teams gesture and the generated /agent-teams-<profile-key> family, i.e. lib/command.js:3-5,12-17,75-76,95-100 + the profiles.* key set; the profiles.mpd key; the mpd preset id)
(dagRunId AND mechanism) OR (envKeyOmo AND workflowTool AND mechanism)
vetoes.effect: action = skip regardless of total; every V4 skip row MUST name the coupling class that fired it

steps: 1. apply pre-checks P1-P3 to the row
2. apply vetoes V1, V3, V4 (any hit => action = skip, stop)
6. any tie/boundary is resolved by THIS order, never case by case

boundarySampleRules.give-me-tips: class = not-applicable (out of the scored row set). Counterfactual score if forced into the row set: D1=0 (target-surface-absent: a tip tour for another product's CLI), D2=1, D3=2 (1 file, no seam, credential mention), D4=1 (HARD credential + SOFT task/category), D5=3 (no local counterpart) => total 12 < 15 => skip. Two independent reasons: class exclusion and the total gate.
boundarySampleRules.onboarding: class = not-applicable (out of the scored row set). Counterfactual: D1=0 (first-run UX of another product), D2=1, D3=1 (seam + credential), D4=0 (HARD senpi CLI + env/home path), D5=3 => total 10 < 15 => skip.
boundarySampleRules.rule: A boundary sample is never special-cased: it is scored by the same pre-checks/vetoes/gates, and BOTH the exclusion rule and the counterfactual arithmetic are printed.

calibrationChecks.assertion: install may legitimately be 0: the row set may contain no 'adoptable' item and no row whose raw coupling is 'none'. A gate that always expects >= 1 install row would be unsound (t4: adoptable=0).
every scored row's action must be re-derivable from (repetition value, D4, total) alone; if a reviewer cannot re-derive it, the row fails this gate.
a row with repetition == 已等价 must NOT be listed as a candidate in decisions.json.
V3 must be evaluated for every row (at least one row must record 'not triggered' with the frozen-name set it was compared against), otherwise the veto could be silently skipped.

requiredColumns: 实施代价(fileCount+dirCount、是否动 harness seam)
与 t5 落地能力的重复度(已等价|部分等价|无增量)

classMapping.authority: frozen-contract.json::t4Requirements.residualFieldGap (a)-(i) — this text wins over any captain message
classMapping.rule: seam-trigger classes are the ONLY ones that can produce a D3 penalty or a V4 hit; soft classes are annotation-only and never add to D3
classMapping.unlistedClassHandling: no third band: an unlisted class (goalTool observed) falls to the soft/D4 axis and is annotation-only
classMapping.caseSensitivity: the frozen class table is CASE-SENSITIVE; uppercase prose never entered a class (git-master "RESET WORKFLOW" / "Autosquash Workflow" are NOT hits); re-deriving with /i is non-compliant
classMapping.contractPinNote: pinned to the revision READ AT FINALISATION per the contract authorityNote (31,705 B / a0d28ebe…, mtime 22:38:13); the implementation-time revision was 28,243 B / a9dfb311… and the (a)(b)(g)/rowSet/binaryDependencyRule clauses are textually identical; the captain advisory three-piece (28,403 B / 380ffc41…) is an earlier revision and is recorded, not used as the pin.

evidenceQuality.rule: precedence over classMapping: only a hit whose evidenceQuality = mechanism counts toward D4; a prose hit is recorded but neither scored nor able to trigger V4

environmentPrerequisites.rule: when the hit is an ordinary environment prerequisite or a domain word (bun in a script, credential exposure, .omo path, senpi CLI) it is recorded as "environment prerequisite: needs X" and NEVER scores
environmentPrerequisites.note: a binary hit that is backed by real executable commands inside the row own SKILL.md is MECHANISM for D4 and also satisfies binaryDependency in the D3 rule

D3Rule.formula: D3 = 1 + (counted TRUE seam booleans), clamped to [0,3]
D3Rule.harnessSeamChange: TRUE iff a SEAM TRIGGER class is present WITH mechanism evidence
D3Rule.binaryDependency: TRUE iff the row own SKILL.md carries an executable command that is part of the porting work
D3Rule.tokenSums: NEVER used (git-master: count 0 vs sum 3; mass-ulw: count 1 vs sum 36)
D3Rule.baseline: 1 (never 0: a port is never literally free)
D3Rule.rawLookup: raw/upstream-skill-records.json; ALL TEN rows have a record — skills-loader-core/security-research has an EMPTY name field and must be looked up BY PATH; there is NO unknown-fallback row
D3Rule.t19: Explorer measured no-seam-required for skills/remove-deadcode: text-level tool renaming inside the ported SKILL.md only, zero repository-side change => harnessSeamChange FALSE, counted = 1 via binaryDependency => D3 = 2

TRUE: skills/remove-deadcode (bun run typecheck = the skill own verification step)
FALSE: skills-loader-core/git-master (its 16 bash/make blocks TEACH git = subject matter, nothing must be installed to PORT it)

d4Mapping.input: counted (mechanism) hits among the SOFT axis classes, per evidenceQuality
d4Mapping.cap: couplingMeasurement != none caps D4 != 3 (contract (f)); all ten rows are non-none, so D4 <= 2 and the 1.0.x "none => 3" band is unreachable here
d4Mapping.publishedBy: this gate (rubric 1.0.1 mapping, re-applied to the counted soft-axis input)

threshold.rule: total >= 15 => adapt-then-install; total < 15 => skip; vetoes apply BEFORE the threshold
threshold.borderline: a row with total == 15 and no veto must be flagged threshold-borderline and listed in userApprovedOverrides
threshold.userApprovedOverrides: user-approved candidates that fall to/below the threshold must be listed with their score, both rule generations and a confirm-or-withdraw note
